tiles: Geometric mountains tower over brightly colored figures
Generative process refined with disciplined finishing
challenge: Exploring how geometric abstraction can convey motion and psychological depth within a landscape format. The goal was to create compositions where constructivist forms suggest emergent figures and shifting perception, blending structured geometry with an almost psychic spatial energy.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to generate base compositions built around layered geometric mountains and color fields. Each piece was refined in Lightroom for color grading and value control, then prepared in Illustrator for print-ready output with disciplined edge work and focal hierarchy.
result: Produced a cohesive series of abstract landscape prints that read clearly at grid scale and reward close inspection at full resolution. The collection is suitable for gallery display, high-quality art prints, and digital provenance editions.
